01 — About

Engineer who
speaks data

Hi, I'm O (Chanoknan) — an Engineer with over 3 years of hands-on experience across Production, Quality, and Design Engineering.

I specialise in optimising factory workflows and reducing operational bottlenecks through actual production trials and root-cause analysis. Experienced in streamlining plant processes by developing AppSheet tools and Google Apps Script to automate daily data collection.

Additionally, I leverage Power BI and Looker Studio to convert complex manufacturing records into clear dashboards for tracking KPIs and supporting management decisions. I also design and maintain SQL databases (Supabase/PostgreSQL) to enable real-time OEE data collection and machine-level monitoring. Currently expanding my analytical capabilities through an M.S. in Data Science.

How it connects

Modules
6 Features, One App
📱 Web App
Accessible from any browser — no installation needed
Open from Safari or Chrome on any device. Can be added to the Home Screen for quick access and a full-screen experience.
01 · Login
Clock In with QR Scan or Employee ID
Select department, machine and shift, then scan employee card or type ID — no username or password needed.
  • Machine list filters automatically by department
  • QR scanner runs in the browser — no extra app to install
  • Employee name is auto-filled after ID scan
02 · Production Input
Scan FG Tag → Record Production Instantly
Scan a Finished Goods tag after each production lot. The system records count, tracks P/Order progress and updates the display live.
  • QR scan auto-fills Part No., P/Order and Tag No.
  • Progress bar shows produced vs. planned quantity
  • Separate fields for Production NG, Setup NG and Breakdown
03 · Real-Time Dashboard
Live Machine Status Dashboard
A real-time dashboard shows every machine as a status card. Cards update instantly when production data or a breakdown is recorded.
  • RUN / DOWN / IDLE shown in distinct colours
  • OEE%, today's FG output and NG% per machine
  • Pareto chart for downtime reasons and defect types
04 · OEE Analysis
OEE Analysis — Drill Down at Every Level
Navigate from plant overview → per machine → per Part. Filter by day, month, department or shift.
  • Gauge meters for Availability, Performance and Quality vs. target
  • OEE loss breakdown as a waterfall chart
  • Daily trend line and machine comparison table
05 · Issue Record
Log Issues with 4M Root-Cause Analysis
Operators report problems from their phones immediately, selecting root-cause category from the 4M framework (Man, Machine, Method, Material).
  • Select Machine, describe the case, and choose Occurs from 4M
  • View all issues filtered by Open, In Progress or Closed
  • Issue records feed directly into the AI for analysis
06 · AI Assistant
AI Chat — Ask Questions, Get Instant Answers
Connected to live production data, the AI answers questions immediately. No need to pull a report or open a spreadsheet.
  • "Which part has the highest defect rate today?"
  • "Which machine has the lowest OEE — is it Availability, Performance or Quality?"
  • "Suggest corrective actions following the 4M framework."
Impact
Before vs. After
Data was recorded on paper and reviewed the next day. Now management sees it live during the shift.
Live

4M
